run_f_gold: run f_gold to decode a median string back to the original string
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input strings and compare outputs to expected results
review_f_gold: review f_gold which alternates prepending and appending characters in pairs to reconstruct a string
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to handle even and odd length strings with cleaner conditional logic
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which takes a median-encoded string and returns the decoded original string
